name: GigaVoxels Ray Traversal and Rendering
definition: A GPU-based volume rendering technique using an octree structure to manage brick-level data, traversing the tree to sample voxel data and performing front-to-back blending.
summary: GigaVoxels is a GPU volume rendering technique that decouples the octree hierarchy from brick-based data storage to enable efficient memory residency and level-of-detail culling.
